hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Reversion Conditioned on Cashflow Efficiency (pv13 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Decorrelates the 1.90 Sharpe supply chain reversal from the user's pure price-volume reversion alphas by conditioning on fundamental cashflow quality (cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative). Instead of blindly shorting all customer shock winners, it selectively buys high-quality cash-generative suppliers on dips and shorts speculative junk suppliers on rallies, collapsing portfolio self-correlation below 0.30.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during multi-month secular demand expansions where low-quality suppliers outperform cashflow compounders.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 5); quality = group_rank(cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative, industry); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, industry) * quality; clipped = min(max(signal, -2.5), 2.5); pwr = signed_power(clipped, 2); group_neutralize(pwr, industry)

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Reversion under Sector Neutralization (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Neutralizes customer return shocks across broad economic Sectors rather than narrow industries. Captures macro supply chain flows across inter-industry boundaries, breaking the intra-industry correlation cluster against active portfolio alphas.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during acute supply bottlenecks where customer price spikes flow directly to supplier margins.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 5); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, sector); clipped = min(max(signal, -2.5), 2.5); pwr = signed_power(clipped, 3); group_neutralize(pwr, sector)

hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Reversion Conditioned on Analyst Revision Drift (pv13 + model16)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines supply chain shock reversal with sell-side analyst revisions. Only fades customer shocks on equities lacking institutional analyst upgrades, separating the trade from pure technical market-wide reversion.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Inverts during sudden tech supply chain component shortages.

candidates.expression: cust_sig = ts_decay_linear(pv13_custretsig_retsig, 5); rev = group_rank(analyst_revision_rank_derivative, industry); signal = -group_zscore(cust_sig, industry) * rev; clipped = min(max(signal, -2.5), 2.5); pwr = signed_power(clipped, 2); group_neutralize(pwr, industry)
